SIGN_IN_DESCRIPTION: Sign in to manage this Arclayer deployment.
CREDENTIALS_DESCRIPTION: Your product sign-in does not carry over to this admin.
SECURITY_CHECK_DESCRIPTION: Confirm it is really you before opening the admin.
SECURITY_KEY_SETUP_DESCRIPTION: Add a security key or passkey before you open the admin.
ADD_SECURITY_KEY_TO_CONTINUE: Add a security key or passkey
USE_SECURITY_KEY_OR_PASSKEY: Use a security key or passkey
AUTHENTICATOR_APP_SETUP_REQUIRED: Set up an authenticator app to protect this administrator account.
AUTHENTICATOR_SETUP_DESCRIPTION: Add this setup key to your authenticator app, then enter the current code.
VERIFICATION_CODE_DESCRIPTION: Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
VERIFICATION_CODE_RETRY: Check the current code and try again.
CURRENT_VERIFICATION_TITLE: Confirm with a current security method
CURRENT_VERIFICATION_DESCRIPTION: Choose an existing method to confirm this account change.
CURRENT_VERIFICATION_CODE_DESCRIPTION: Enter the code currently shown by the selected authenticator app.
RECOVERY_CODES_DESCRIPTION: Store these one-time codes somewhere safe. You will not see them again.
RECOVERY_CODES_SAVED_CONFIRMATION: I saved these recovery codes in a secure place.
SIGN_OUT_DESCRIPTION: This device will return to the Admin sign-in page.
SIGN_OUT_CONSEQUENCE: Only this device is signed out. The product app and your other devices are not affected.
SIGN_OUT_UNCHANGED: Your current sign-in is still active. Try again.
ERROR_TITLE: Can't load access and security information
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: Current access and security status can't be confirmed.
PERMISSION_DESCRIPTION: Ask the Instance Owner or an authorized Platform team member for access.
EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: There are no records to show.
TEAM_DESCRIPTION: See who can operate this deployment and which invitations still need a response.
INVITE_OPERATOR_DESCRIPTION: Invite an existing account to the Platform team and configure the roles granted after acceptance and security setup.
PERSON_SEARCH_HELP: Search active Arclayer accounts by name, email address, or username.
PERSON_SEARCH_ERROR: People couldn't be loaded. Close this window and try again.
INVITE_ROLES_HELP: When the invitation is accepted, the latest eligible roles and access are checked again.
OPERATOR_INVITED: The team member invitation was sent and is now waiting for acceptance.
INVITE_REQUIRED_FIELDS: Choose a person and at least one role.
ACTION_FAILED: The change could not be completed
ACTION_ERROR: The service didn't apply this change. Check the current status and try again.
ACTION_PERMISSION_ERROR: You don't have permission to make this change.
ACTION_CONFLICT_ERROR: The team changed while you were working. Refresh and review the latest status.
ACTION_VALIDATION_ERROR: Review the selected person, roles, and expiry.
OWNER_DESCRIPTION: One person always holds this responsibility. It can't be delegated.
OPERATORS_DESCRIPTION: Review each member's roles, security setup, and device activity.
OPERATORS_EMPTY: No Platform team members are recorded.
INVITATIONS_DESCRIPTION: Review pending invitations and those that are no longer effective.
INVITATION_DESCRIPTION: Review the identity, role outcome, and current invitation status.
ROLES_DESCRIPTION: See the roles available in this deployment and the actions they allow.
ROLE_CATALOG_DESCRIPTION: Built-in and custom roles currently set up for this deployment.
SIGN_IN_SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Configure account registration, OAuth sign-in, and multi-factor verification for the current administrator.
REGISTRATION_CONFIGURATION_DESCRIPTION: Control who can create an account and which email checks registration must complete.
PUBLIC_REGISTRATION_DESCRIPTION: Allow people without an invitation to create an account from the product sign-in page. Existing accounts can still sign in when this is off.
REQUIRE_EMAIL_DESCRIPTION: Every newly registered account must provide an email address.
REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_DESCRIPTION: New accounts must verify their email address before registration completes.
ALLOWED_DOMAINS_DESCRIPTION: Enter one domain per line. Leave this empty to allow every domain.
ACCOUNT_PROVISIONING_DESCRIPTION: Control whether first-time OAuth sign-in creates an account and accepts invitations sent to a verified email address.
AUTO_PROVISION_DESCRIPTION: Create an account for a new person whose OAuth identity satisfies the registration policy.
AUTO_ACCEPT_INVITES_DESCRIPTION: After OAuth confirms the email address, accept valid invitations sent to that address.
SIGN_IN_SETTINGS_SAVED: Sign-in and registration settings were saved.
SIGN_IN_SETTINGS_SAVE_ERROR: The service did not apply these settings. Review the current configuration and try again.
SIGN_IN_SETTINGS_CONFLICT: The settings changed while you were editing. Refresh the page and review them again.
SIGN_IN_SETTINGS_SECURITY_POLICY_ERROR: This deployment's security verification policy is not ready. No settings were changed. Complete the deployment update and try again.
SIGN_IN_SETTINGS_VERIFICATION_EXPIRED: This security verification expired or no longer matches the current settings. Save again and complete verification.
SIGN_IN_SETTINGS_VALIDATION_ERROR: Review the registration rules and email domains. The service did not apply these settings.
SIGN_IN_SETTINGS_READ_ONLY_DESCRIPTION: You can review sign-in and registration rules, but editing requires the Manage sign-in settings permission.
IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_DESCRIPTION: Installed sign-in services and their setup status.
PROVIDER_CARD_DESCRIPTION: Configure the OAuth client credentials Arclayer uses for sign-in.
PROVIDER_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: Confirm your identity with a security key or passkey before saving. The client secret is never shown again after it is stored.
ENABLE_PROVIDER_DESCRIPTION: The service can be enabled only after both the client ID and client secret are configured.
PROVIDER_CLIENT_ID_DESCRIPTION: Copy the client ID from the OAuth service's application settings.
PROVIDER_CLIENT_SECRET_DESCRIPTION: Enter the client secret generated by the OAuth service. It is never shown again after saving.
PROVIDER_CLIENT_SECRET_REPLACE_DESCRIPTI: Leave this empty to keep the current secret, or enter a new value to replace it immediately.
CLEAR_PROVIDER_SECRET_DESCRIPTION: New sign-in requests through this service stop after the secret is cleared.
PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED: Enter both the client ID and client secret before enabling this sign-in service.
PROVIDER_SAVED: The OAuth sign-in service configuration was saved.
PROVIDER_SAVE_ERROR: The service did not apply this OAuth configuration. Review the current state and try again.
DELETE_PROVIDER_DESCRIPTION: The client ID, client secret, and enabled state will be deleted. New OAuth sign-ins stop immediately; existing accounts and sessions are unchanged.
PROVIDER_DELETED: The OAuth sign-in service configuration was deleted.
OAUTH_READ_ONLY_DESCRIPTION: You can review OAuth sign-in service status, but configuration and editing require the Manage sign-in settings permission.
SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Review verified security methods and active Platform sessions for this account.
MFA_DESCRIPTION: See the available security methods and their verification status.
MFA_EMPTY: No verified security methods are set up yet.
MFA_READ_ONLY_DESCRIPTION: You can review current security methods, but adding, replacing, or removing them requires the Reset multi-factor verification permission.
DEVICE_SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: See active sessions by device. Tokens and device fingerprints are never shown.
REVOKE_OTHER_SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Sessions on every other Platform device will end on their next request. This device and product app sessions stay signed in.
REVOKE_CURRENT_SESSION_DESCRIPTION: The Platform session on {{device}} will end immediately and Arclayer Admin will return to sign-in. Product app sessions are unchanged.
REVOKE_SESSION_DESCRIPTION: The Platform session on {{device}} will end on its next request. Other Platform and product app sessions are unchanged.
SESSION_REVOKE_CONSEQUENCE: This also ends any security verification linked to the session. It doesn't remove the team member or change roles.
OTHER_SESSIONS_REVOKED: The other device sessions were revoked
SESSION_REVOKE_SUCCESS_DESCRIPTION: The service confirmed the change, and the active device list was refreshed.
SESSION_REVOKE_ERROR: The device session could not be revoked
SESSION_REVOKE_PERMISSION_ERROR: You don't have permission to revoke this session
SESSION_REVOKE_UNCHANGED: No session was revoked. Review the current device list and try again.
SESSIONS_EMPTY: No active Platform sessions are recorded.
MANAGE_ROLES_DESCRIPTION: Set the complete role list for {{name}}. Saving adds newly selected roles and removes roles you clear.
MANAGE_ROLES_HELP: Keep only the responsibilities this person needs. Clearing every role leaves the team member active without role-based access.
NO_ROLES_AVAILABLE: No active roles are available in this deployment.
SECURITY_KEY_REQUIRED: Use a security key or passkey to continue.
SECURITY_KEY_CANCELLED: Security key or passkey verification was cancelled. The request was not completed; try again to continue.
SECURITY_KEY_UNAVAILABLE: Security key or passkey verification is unavailable on this device. Use a compatible device or browser, then try again.
SECURITY_KEY_ACTION_SETUP_REQUIRED: Add a security key or passkey to the current Platform account before performing this action.
ROLES_UPDATED: The team member's role assignments were updated.
REVOKE_INVITATION_DESCRIPTION: {{name}} will no longer be able to accept this invitation. Their existing Platform access is unchanged.
REVOKE_INVITATION_CONSEQUENCE: The invitation becomes invalid immediately. To invite this person later, send a new invitation.
CREATE_ROLE_DESCRIPTION: Create a role with only the responsibilities people need to do their work.
COPY_ROLE_DESCRIPTION: Start with this role's responsibilities, then create a separate role you can change.
EDIT_ROLE_DESCRIPTION: Review how changing {{name}} affects people and pending invitations before applying it.
ROLE_CODE_HELP: Use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores. This identifier cannot be changed after the role is created.
ROLE_DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: Describe the work and scope this role is responsible for
ROLE_PERMISSIONS_HELP: Choose the access this role grants. People assigned this role receive the selected responsibilities.
NO_DELEGABLE_PERMISSIONS: No responsibilities are available for this role. Ask the Instance Owner to review what you can delegate.
NO_DELEGABLE_PERMISSIONS_MATCH: No delegable responsibilities match your search.
ROLE_PERMISSION_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search responsibilities, permission codes, or domains…
ROLE_COPIED: A new role was created from the selected role.
ROLE_CHANGE_IMPACT_DESCRIPTION: Review who will gain or lose access before applying this role change.
INVALIDATED_INVITATIONS: Invitations that will no longer work
RETIRE_ROLE_DESCRIPTION: Retiring {{name}} removes it from current assignments and prevents new use of the role.
RETIRE_ROLE_CONSEQUENCE: Team members assigned this role lose its access, and pending invitations using it no longer work. Assign another role first if that access is still needed.
ADD_AUTHENTICATOR_APP_DESCRIPTION: Add another authenticator app to protect Platform access. It is usable only after you confirm the code it provides.
AUTHENTICATOR_SETUP_KEY_HELP: Enter this key in your authenticator app, then enter the current code it shows.
REPLACE_AUTHENTICATOR_APP_DESCRIPTION: Verify the new authenticator app first. The old method is removed only after the replacement succeeds.
ADD_SECURITY_KEY_DESCRIPTION: Add another security key or passkey to protect Platform access. You will confirm it before it is added.
SECURITY_KEY_ADDED: The security key or passkey was added.
REPLACE_SECURITY_KEY_DESCRIPTION: Verify the new security key or passkey first. The old method is removed only after the replacement succeeds.
SECURITY_KEY_REPLACED: The security key or passkey was replaced.
REMOVE_MFA_METHOD_DESCRIPTION: {{method}} will no longer protect this account's Platform access. Verify the change to remove it.
REMOVE_MFA_METHOD_CONSEQUENCE: Other verified security methods remain available. You must verify a replacement before removing the last method.
ACCOUNT_SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Manage your Platform account, verification methods, signed-in devices, and interface preferences.
ACCOUNT_PROFILE_DESCRIPTION: These details come from your signed-in identity. Team roles manage Platform access separately.
ACCOUNT_PROFILE_DISPLAY_NAME_PLACEHOLDER: Enter the name shown in the Platform Console
ACCOUNT_PROFILE_NAME_HELP: Account name and email belong to the sign-in identity. You can update the display name here.
ACCOUNT_PROFILE_UPDATE_ERROR: The account profile could not be updated. Review it and try again.
ACCOUNT_DELETE_OWNER_DESCRIPTION: The Instance Owner cannot delete their account directly. Complete a two-person ownership transfer, then remove the former owner's Platform access.
ACCOUNT_DELETE_MEMBER_DESCRIPTION: Platform access must be removed before account deletion so authority and session records are not left behind.
ACCOUNT_SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Review current Platform sessions and revoke devices you no longer use.
ACCOUNT_LANGUAGE_DESCRIPTION: Choose the language used by the Platform Console.
ACCOUNT_THEME_DESCRIPTION: Use light, dark, or your system preference.
TEAM_MEMBERS_DESCRIPTION: Review the Instance Owner and Platform team members in one table, including identity, roles, security, and device activity.
TEAM_MEMBERS_EMPTY: No team members match your search.
REMOVED_MEMBERS_DESCRIPTION: Retained member history supports access lifecycle audits.
REMOVED_MEMBERS_EMPTY: No removed Platform access records are available.
REMOVE_OPERATOR_DESCRIPTION: Remove {{name}} from the Platform team while preserving their activity and Audit history.
REMOVE_OPERATOR_IMPACT: This ends {{roleCount}} role assignments and revokes {{sessionCount}} active sessions.
REMOVE_OPERATOR_REASON_HELP: Explain why this person no longer needs Platform access. The reason is recorded in Audit.
REMOVE_OPERATOR_CONSEQUENCE: This does not delete the Product account, Workspace access, or historical records. Returning requires a new invitation.
OPERATOR_SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Review active Platform sessions for {{name}} and revoke a device when access is no longer trusted.
OPERATOR_SESSIONS_EMPTY: This team member has no retained Platform session records.
REVOKE_OPERATOR_SESSION_CONSEQUENCE: That device will lose Platform access immediately. Other devices and Product sessions are unchanged.
RESET_OPERATOR_MFA_DESCRIPTION: Remove the current Platform verification methods for {{name}} and require a new setup.
RESET_OPERATOR_MFA_IMPACT_TITLE: This blocks Platform access until setup is complete
RESET_OPERATOR_MFA_IMPACT: This will revoke {{methodCount}} verification method(s) and {{sessionCount}} active Platform session(s).
RESET_OPERATOR_MFA_REASON_HELP: Record why recovery is required. This note is retained with the security audit event.
RESET_OPERATOR_MFA_CONSEQUENCE: Roles remain assigned, but this team member cannot use them until identity verification and a new multi-factor setup are complete.
OPERATOR_MFA_RESET: Verification recovery was started. Existing Platform sessions are no longer valid.
BUILT_IN_ROLE_ACCESS_SECURITY_DESCRIPTIO: Manages Platform team access, roles, sign-in policy, MFA recovery, and device sessions.
BUILT_IN_ROLE_OPERATIONS_DESCRIPTION: Reviews requests, audit activity, and service issues without changing access settings.
BUILT_IN_ROLE_TENANT_DESCRIPTION: Operates tenant users, workspaces, projects, support access, and governed rollouts.
BUILT_IN_ROLE_COMMERCE_DESCRIPTION: Manages plans, subscriptions, credits, payment services, and billing records.
PERMISSION_DOMAIN_DESCRIPTION: Roles use these responsibilities to grant Platform pages and actions.
PERMISSION_COPY_DESCRIPTION: Allows a role to {{action}} {{resource}} in the Platform Console.
